name: Ravileela Granites Limited
about: Ravileela Granites Limited manufactures and trades in granite slabs and tiles in India. The company offers polished, honed, flamed, brushed, antique, bush hammered, sand blasted, tumbled, and straight edge granite slabs. It also exports its products to the United States, Ireland, the United Kingdom, Poland, Switzerland, Italy, South Africa, Germany, Austria, the Czech Republic, etc. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
